threads.body: The non-follow-up Slack message uses wording "moved to waiting on approvers", but `notification_due()` returns "initial" in cases that don’t necessarily imply a state transition (e.g., newly assigned reviewer, or first notification after a missed/failed run). Consider using more neutral wording like "is waiting on approvers" for the initial notification to avoid misleading recipients.

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/commit/e296847d0065664c47d81b40e0b6078b7e3238ef.

This keeps transition-style initial notifications as “moved to waiting on approvers” while skipping Slack notifications for newly seen assignees on the same waiting period.
